sourceReview: Rajasthan Revenue Board is the relevant state cadastral custodian, and the official NIC Bhu-Naksha viewer is a local/state cadastral-map route. Rajdharaa is an official urban GIS portal with Khasra search and explicitly identifies Settlement Department boundaries, but it is not evidence of an open parcel-feature response for this city.
